policy.method: Bounded overlapping source slabs. Each 96-sample accepted core has 40 real fine samples of halo, greater than the allowed fragment extent plus retained-tissue guard. Components touching any processing boundary are retained. Only core pixels are committed, avoiding overlap double counts.

tiles.method: 26-connected components of the complete local sigma0.5 source foreground. Only fully interior small candidates are selected; preserve elongated components and all crop-face components. Exact logical-grid mask includes a bounded mesh halo and a wider guard around every retained source component.

policy.scope: Small detached RV/apical and chordal-region fragments only; connected trabeculae, papillary muscles and long chord-like components retained.
